idle.title: Unsubscribe from reminder emails
idle.body: We will stop the photo reminders, plan follow-ups and the weekly matches email. Emails about payments, your membership dates, sign-in codes and account security will still reach you.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.body: Open the latest email from us and use the unsubscribe link at the bottom, or write to us and we will do it for you.

done.title: You are unsubscribed
done.body: We will not send you reminder emails. Emails about payments, membership dates and account security will still reach you.

undone.title: Reminder emails are back on
undone.body: You will get our reminder emails again. You can turn them off from the link at the bottom of any of them.
